final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM event_averages) SELECT ea.event_name, ea.avg_amount, ea.avg_amount - o.overall_avg, ea.avg_amount / o.overall_avg FROM event_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ea.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
